note: Revolut design references under /samples. Kept out of navigation.json on purpose: that file is the source of truth for the real route tree and the catch-all generates every href in it, so a sample listed there would collide with its own page.tsx. Adding an entry here adds it to the header dropdown and the /samples index; the page itself lives at src/app/(samples)/samples/<slug>/page.tsx.
